title: A DEFINE COLUMN can be a group-by column of SUMMARIZECOLUMNS
query: DEFINE COLUMN Product[Price Band] = IF ( Product[Price] >= 50, "High", "Low" )
EVALUATE SUMMARIZECOLUMNS ( Product[Price Band], "Sales Amount", [Sales Amount] ) ORDER BY Product[Price Band]

source.quote: The syntax after COLUMN defines a query column, which has a data lineage and it is populated in an empty filter context before the query is executed.
source.supports: the page shows a query column used as the group-by column of SUMMARIZECOLUMNS

derivation: High: Bike (100) and Scooter (50); Bike rows 1, 5, 7 = 400, Scooter has no sales. Low: Helmet (20) rows 2, 3 = 60 and Lock (10) rows 4, 6 = 80, together 140.
